source_name: Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre, National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal
text: Cyber Dost alert: There is no such thing as a 'digital arrest'. Police, CBI, Customs or RBI officers never question or arrest anyone over a video call and never ask you to transfer money to a 'safe account'. If you get such a call, disconnect and report it at www.cybercrime.gov.in or call 1930. -I4C, MHA
notes: Written by us from the public template or description at source_url for the false-positive hunt (2026-09-30). Names, numbers and references are placeholders; official contacts are the ones the organisation publishes. Not a verbatim copy of a real message.
